info.title: Fenergo Nebula External Data Outreach Command
info.description: External Data Outreach Command API provides methods related to the Portal Outreach. It should be used to update Outreach Entity Data.

put.description:
Updates an existing outreach entity data

Required permissions:
At least one of the following permissions is required: EntityDataEdit, EntityGroupManagementEdit

parameters.name: X-TENANT-ID
parameters.description: The UiD of the tenant representing organization

requestBody.description: Update outreach entity data request. Must contain Policy jurisdiction(s) and entity draft properties.

400.description: Bad request. The request has missing/invalid values.

messages.message: Not Found. Outreach entity data with given journey id does not exist.

409.description: Conflict saving changes in expected version

messages.message: There are conflicts that cannot be resolved automatically, get latest and apply your changes

202.description: Success. Outreach entity data updated. Validation errors will be returned for invalid properties.

401.description: User is not authorized to perform this request

messages.message: Access denied. Following permissions are required: Permission1, Permission2

500.description: Internal server exception. Please, contact your provider.

messages.message: Internal server exception. Please, contact your provider.

410.description: Endpoint marked as deprecated was terminated. This response will be present only if the endpoint was marked as deprecated and has reached the sunset date. During the deprecation period, the API will include additional 'sunset' and 'deprecation' headers.

messages.message: This endpoint is obsolete and was terminated on yyyy-MM-dd

category.description: List of requirement category e.g. ["Basic Details", "Enrich Details"]

version.description:
Current version of the Draft where you want to apply your changes. This parameter is required 
to guarantee consistency and conflicts detection. If it is not provided, it will save new changes
on top of latest without conflicts checking

EntityDraftDto.description: Request DTO to update entity draft

dataSources.description: Additional data sources used for evaluation

triggerValidation.description: If true, it will trigger validation of the entity draft

version.description: Version of outreach data after update

hasValidationErrors.description: Flag indicating occurrence of validation errors for invalid properties

OutreachDataCommandResponseDto.description: Response DTO representing updated outreach data

data.description: Response DTO representing updated outreach data

Bearer.description: Please insert JWT with Bearer into field
Bearer.name: Authorization
